essence: The excess should be given in one-two-three sequence according to seasonal proportion.
The division may be made either as seven-seven-eight parts or as five-five-six parts.
Thus the liṅga with Śiva-excess is to be applied in order to the Brāhma and other types.
For Rudra and other types, the diameter is determined by divisions of six, seven, and eight in order.
Aja and other types are proportioned by three and four parts within a ninefold liṅga measure.
